Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Abstract Decorative Throw Pillow, 20" x 20", Purple
Colors: Purple
Various tones of purple, green, and black yarns are woven to form abstract circles on this eye-catching pillow. For a different look, it reverses to a solid grey side. This pillow will liven up a transitional or modern style bedroom. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
